It stays near its floor on a multi-token word's first piece, on 'and' joining two adjectives or two clauses, and on ordinary prose; the interior-piece half is a learned set (24 uncommon multi-piece words tested, about 6 fired), so an unfamiliar interior piece is more likely inactive than active.
